 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Weather Weather Scattered rains, thunderstorms over western Mindanao due to ITCZ — PAGASA 
 By GMA News Published October 26, 2026 4:32am 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. The Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) will bring cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms over the western section of Mindanao on Monday, PAGASA reported.
 As of 2 a.m., no Low Pressure Areas (LPAs) are being monitored for Tropical Cyclone Formation.
 Forecast Weather Conditions 
 Zamboanga Peninsula, Misamis Occidental, Basilan, and Tawi-Tawi will have cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms due to the ITCZ and flash floods or landslides may occur due to moderate to at times heavy rains.
 Other Stories

 ITCZ brings rains, thunderstorms to Visayas, Mindanao, Bicol, Palawan
 ITCZ to bring rains over Palawan, Visayas, Mindanao on Sunday — PAGASA
 Batanes and Babuyan Islands will have partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated light rains due to the northeasterly windflow but with no significant impact.
 Metro Manila and the rest of the country will have partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms due to localized thunderstorms and flash floods or landslides may occur during severe thunderstorms.
 Forecast Wind and Coastal Water Conditions 
 The wind speed forecast for extreme Northern Luzon is moderate and moving northeastward while coastal waters will be moderate to rough.
 The rest of the country will experience light to moderate wind speed moving northeastward with slight to moderate coastal waters.
 Sunrise will be at 5:50 a.m., sunset at 5:30 p.m. — BAP, GMA News
